content.description: Hand removing two pins from front valve plate housing

content.text: Remove the two pins from the front housing. Discard the pins.

content.description: Hand using hammer and punch to remove rear housing from compressor

content.text: Using a hammer and punch, remove the rear housing by tapping on the protrusion.
CAUTION: Be careful not to scratch the sealing surface of the rear housing.

content.description: Hands removing O-rings from cylinder block of compressor

content.text: 12. REMOVE FRONT AND REAR O-RINGS FROM CYLINDER BLOCK

content.description: Hand installing rear valve plate on rear cylinder of compressor

content.text: 1. INSTALL REAR VALVE PLATE ON REAR CYLINDER

items: (a) Install the two pins in the rear cylinder.
(b) Lubricate a new O-ring with compressor oil. Install the O-ring in the rear cylinder.

content.description: Rear suction valve being installed over pins on rear cylinder

items: (c) Install the rear suction valve over the pins on the rear cylinder.

content.text: NOTE: The front and rear suction valves are the same.
